reason: Kernel side is feasible, but the lab test as written cannot be run in 2 days. KERNEL: predict_video uses W=2 windows with stride 1, about 99 per video. Each window is read with zarr[t, ::1, ::4, ::4] from 64x256x256 full-res frames. The slices d::4 for d=1..3 each give exactly 64 rows, so there is no pad or trilinear-interpolate artefact. Three extra primary encodes per window against 16 today is +18.75% encodes. exp51 ran in 1,713 s on the 4 dummy videos, and hidden-test scoring for this class is about 6 h against a 12 h limit (x138 guards at 27,000 s), so runtime fits but must be measured. The exp51 string-patch builder already carries float coords, so the per-peak +-1-cell phase argmax is about 0.5-1 day of work. One detail: the phase-0 reference must be the primary non-TTA logits (clone det_logits before the flip/rot accumulation). The TTA ensemble mixes floor and ceil conventions. LAB, this is where it fails: replay.py starts at the POST-GAP checkpoint (header l.1-12: 'the raw -> ckpt part is NOT replayed'). Motion relink (tight 5.5), gap closing and gap2 are baked into ckpt/<stem>.npz. So 'refined coords substituted into the raw nodes, all post-processing re-run' is not something the lab does. The only raw->ckpt path is relink55/build_t55_cache.py, which has three problems. (i) It needs the 80 GB train frames for gap-point refinement. (ii) It answers the DeepCenter gap veto from an ORACLE keyed by (t, refined point), so every gap point that moves with refined coords becomes UNKNOWN and defaults to accept. That confounds treatment against control, and the veto alone was worth 0.0024 on 12 videos. (iii) It needs CPU DivNet rescoring of moved synthetic parents. That build took many hours for one arm on 199 videos, and the plan has 5 arms (A-E) x selection + confirmation. Arms D/E also need V1284-head coordinates on friend A's node set. No such capture exists, and in x138 the head acts before the edge network (trilinear gather), so a probs-fixed arm D is only an approximation. Finally, the gate 'N_pred identical' cannot be met: moved coords change final N through the post-processing (the coordhead port changed final nodes by -2.9%). With about 5 days left, a full-size probe also costs 1.5 GPU-h plus about a day of lab engineering, for a mechanism the research bounds at +0.001-0.002 before linefit. That is below the +0.002 gate.
fix_if_any: Ship-as-tested placement plus a minimal 2-arm test. (1) KERNEL: compute the 3 diagonal-phase primary passes (d=1,2,3) inside the window loop. Keep the phase-0 primary logits (cloned before TTA). Store refined y,x (mean_d(4*j_d+d)+1.5 px, disagreement>4 px -> keep, |shift|<=1.2 um, per-video median recentring) as a node attribute. SWAP THEM IN AFTER the gap/gap2 stage and before safe divisions, short-track filtering, linefit, edge filter and insertion. Relink, gap closing, ILP and edge probs then see the original grid coords, so the kernel does exactly what the ckpt-based lab replays. (2) CAPTURE: one GPU kernel over the competition train input, primary seed only, 4 passes (phase 0 + 3) per window. For each raw node in friend A's cache (key t,z,y,x -> raw node id = dc/ ids) write refined y,x plus a consistency flag. Run 24 videos first (about 15 GPU-min, Phase-1 GT-distance kill test: median drop >= 5% on both embryos), then all 199 (about 1-1.5 GPU-h, 2 shards). (3) LAB: a ~30-line patch in replay.load_ckpt that overwrites y,x of raw nodes (syn=0, id in dc/) by id. Leave synthetic gap nodes unchanged (or re-midpoint them). Tolerate the node_p coord check (it is only counted, l.903). Run SELECTION then CONFIRMATION for A vs B only, on Kaggle CPU via tools/kaggle_lab.py. Gate: >= +0.002, per embryo >= +0.001, win rate, CI. Report the N_pred change and adj-J decomposed into edge J and the multiplier, instead of requiring identical N_pred. Drop arm C (a constant offset; lost 0.0031 on the LB for another team). Defer D/E until a head capture on the cache nodes exists. Total about 1.5 GPU-h and about 1 day of engineering.
realistic_public_gain: +0.000..+0.001 public on top of the V1284 coordinate head (both remove the same grid error). At most +0.001..+0.002 standalone. The measured dose-response bounds it: one extra xy quantisation costs only 0.001-0.002 edge recall before linefit. Likely to fail the +0.002 lab gate. Worth running only if the Phase-1 distance readout (about 15 GPU-min) shows >= 5% centre-error reduction on both embryos, or if the head port stalls.
